summary.content:
Today's selection covers 84 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 57 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Chinese A.I. Models Gain Ground on Anthropic and OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Phishers Gain Persistence at EU, Asia Hospitality Orgs
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Ars Technica and others
• **Fresh Content**: 58 articles published in the last 24 hours
